question: Will gold futures settle above $4,150 on Friday, August 7?

model.prompt_context: Resolves YES if the official CME daily settlement price for Gold Futures (GC), as published on the CME Group Gold Futures Settlements page (cmegroup.com/markets/metals/precious/gold.settlements.html) for the trade date of August 7, 2026, is strictly greater than $4,150.00 per troy ounce. A settlement price of exactly $4,150.00 or below resolves NO.

data_sources: CME Group – Gold Futures Daily Settlements (cmegroup.com/markets/metals/precious/gold.settlements.html)
